title: Collaboration UI-to-backend wiring remediation
principle: Repair one reviewed user-action boundary at a time. An enabled Collaboration control is not delivered until a composed UI interaction reaches its intended effect under behavioral regression tests.

known_state_debt.follow_up: A separately approved document-provider sprint must own provider, encrypted outbox, live Saving/Offline/Conflict transitions, reload resume, and conflict mutations.

tickets.title: Isolate self-device and member-device revocation actions
scope: Prevent member controls from reaching revokeThisDevice or the current browser lifecycle.
Create an action-reachability harness backed by the exact known-action-debt inventory.
acceptance_criteria: The current-device control still revokes only the current registered device.
A member-row control cannot clear the current device store, acting-device header, or local private key.
Member-device revocation remains visibly disabled with an announced reason until CF-P7R-006 supplies an exact target journey.
The reachability harness rejects new unowned enabled actions and requires this ticket's collision debt to resolve.

tickets.title: Wire the one-time invitation Copy link action
scope: Dispatch Copy link through the injected Clipboard API boundary.
Preserve one-time token privacy and a usable manual-copy fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Copy writes the exact held URL without navigation, logging, persistence, or a network request.
A successful write clears the in-memory holder and repaints so the secret cannot be copied twice.
A refused clipboard keeps the readonly URL and announces the manual-copy path.
Composed entry and browser tests click the rendered control rather than calling the journey directly.

tickets.title: Wire invitation revocation end to end
scope: Dispatch Revoke through the existing invitation journey, service, and runtime route.
Refresh the exact workspace invitation state after one idempotent mutation.
acceptance_criteria: One click sends one DELETE for the exact workspace and invitation with CSRF and a fresh idempotency key.
Double submission is blocked while the request is in flight.
Success removes or refreshes the pending row without clearing an unrelated held URL.
Refusal preserves the row, maps the server reason, and permits a deliberate retry.

tickets.title: Reconcile and wire invitation acceptance end to end
scope: Reconcile the frozen InvitationAcceptRequest with the Preview runtime.
Dispatch Accept using the held fragment token and current active device.
acceptance_criteria: The runtime accepts token and deviceId and requires deviceId to equal the authenticated acting-device header.
The fragment is removed before paint and never reaches path, query, logs, cache, or persistent storage.
One click produces one idempotent mutation and success renders only pending_key.
Replay, expired, revoked, wrong-subject, wrong-device, and refusal outcomes fail closed.

tickets.title: Wire Sign out without touching device key material
scope: Dispatch Sign out through the existing session service.
Keep session failure and device key lifecycle boundaries explicit.
acceptance_criteria: One click sends one logout request and prevents double submission.
Only success forgets session and CSRF state and renders the signed-out surface.
A refusal preserves a usable session for retry.
No sign-out path revokes a device, clears its store, or destroys local key material.

tickets.title: Wire member administration, device targeting, and key provisioning
scope: Formally reconcile API and UI contracts for roleVersion, expectedRoleVersion, confirmations, and six member actions.
Wire role/admin changes, removal, ownership transfer, and a separate remote-device revocation journey.
Build the missing target provisioning journey: authorized device inventory, current-envelope unwrap, in-memory DEK lifecycle, target wrap, and envelope PUT.
acceptance_criteria: Every enabled member action reaches an exact target with the required precondition and idempotency key.
Role selection, admin revocation, TRANSFER_OWNERSHIP confirmation, stale refresh, and REAUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED have explicit UX.
Remote device revocation never reuses the actor's local revocation lifecycle.
Provisioning binds workspace, user, device, public JWK, fingerprint, and key version while plaintext DEK remains browser-only.

tickets.title: Wire Audit activity pagination
scope: Dispatch Show older activity with the backend-issued opaque cursor.
Append a bounded audit page without cross-workspace or stale-response leakage.
acceptance_criteria: The request carries the exact opaque cursor unchanged and never constructs or decodes it.
Pages append without duplicates and a failure preserves the current events.
Double clicks produce one request and a terminal cursor disables the control with an announced reason.
Workspace switching resets cursor and accumulated audit data; stale responses cannot append afterward.

tickets.title: Close enabled-action debt and state the document-provider boundary truthfully
scope: Wire the small workspace-create shortcut and close the final action-debt inventory.
Disable every conflict control that has no live provider with accessible, explicit deferred reasoning.
Stop presenting placeholder Saved as a live document-sync claim and record the missing provider/outbox as a follow-up sprint.
acceptance_criteria: No enabled Collaboration control lacks a composed handler and behavioral test.
Review, reapply, save-copy, discard, cancel, and dismiss cannot appear enabled without a live conflict provider.
The UI states that no collaborative document is active instead of deriving Saved from fixed empty inputs.
The full document provider, encrypted outbox, live sync transitions, reload resume, and conflict mutations remain recorded deferred scope rather than claimed delivery.
